Small technical note to call out a potential rollout hazard.

We have a toggle-based rollout for Model v1.3, but the current autoscaling profile for the dedicated pool doesn't include the short-tail burst pattern we see in pilot telemetry. If we flip the toggle at 9am PT for customer ramp, request latency may spike for 5-10m while nodes scale.

Proposed mitigations (owner: Karthik Iyer / Marcus Lin):
- Pre-warm an additional 20% capacity in the dedicated pool 30m before scheduled ramp.
- Set a temporary token-based rate limit per-customer at 1.25x normal to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Ops runbook: attach ops_runbook_draft.docx — please review for escalation window and rollback trigger (suggested rollback threshold: average latency >= 750ms for 3 consecutive minutes).

Region note: if any pilot customers are EU-based, we should also confirm EU pool capacity separately.

Karthik
Head of Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
